text: DIAGNOSTICS only (parse_help.rs): the `type`-in-a-fn help needs `type <Name>` then `=`, `{` or `<` (a field named `type` gets none), the `**` power help reads the line without a trailing `//` comment, and `return fn(..)` gets the lambda help. Diagnostic codes, messages, line/col and exit codes are unchanged; no program's pass/fail moves.
